title: Inventories
summary: Prescribes measurement of inventories at the lower of cost and net realizable value (or current replacement cost for no/nominal-charge distribution), cost formulas, NRV write-downs and reversals, and fair-value disclosures. The Stripping Costs amendment (Nov 2024, effective 2027) is embedded authoritatively.
description: IPSAS 12 Inventories prescribes the measurement and disclosure of inventories, including lower of cost and NRV, current replacement cost for give-away inventory, cost formulas, and NRV write-downs.
